description: LocationLists compiles the complete list of locations a brand publishes in its own official store or dealer locator — Bobcat, Caterpillar, STIHL, Generac, Home Depot, Waffle House and 260+ more — plus licensed trade contractors by state and association member directories. Ask for a brand or a type of location, see how many records exist and which fields each row carries (name, address, city, state, ZIP, phone, latitude, longitude, website and brand-specific fields such as dealer tier or product lines), check when the file was last rebuilt, and view ten real rows. Full datasets are downloaded from locationlists.com.

defaultPrompt: Find every Bobcat dealer in the US and show me what the data looks like.
Which generator brands have dealer location datasets, and how many dealers does each have?
Show me ten sample rows from the STIHL dealer list and tell me when it was last updated.
